featured_reviews.name: Ajay Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
would like to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation for the excellent care provided by my ENT doctor during my ear surgery. From the very first consultation, the doctor was extremely professional, patient, and thorough in explaining my condition and the treatment plan.
The surgery was handled with great expertise and precision, which gave me a lot of confidence and comfort. The doctor ensured that I clearly understood every step of the procedure, including the risks and recovery process. This transparency helped reduce my anxiety significantly.
Post-surgery care was equally commendable. The doctor was attentive, responsive, and always available to address my concerns during the recovery period. Thanks to their guidance and treatment, my healing process has been smooth and effective.

I would highly recommend this ENT specialist to anyone looking for reliable and expert care.

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Dure
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this hospital.

Despite there being very few patients, I was required to wait approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour while experiencing significant pain and discomfort. Furthermore, after being called in, I was sent back to the waiting area and had to wait for an additional 20 minutes. This process was repeated multiple times, as the queue appeared to be restarted after each patient, resulting in unnecessary delays and frustration.

During the consultation, I felt that my concerns were not properly addressed. The doctor did not provide satisfactory answers to my questions and appeared to be occupied with a mobile phone during the visit. Additionally, the scopy procedure was not performed by the doctor and was instead carried out by a staff member, which raised concerns regarding the quality of care and professional standards being maintained.

The treatment was quite expensive, yet my health issue remained unresolved. Considering the cost, I expected a much higher standard of medical attention, professionalism, communication, and patient care.

Overall, the excessive waiting time, repeated delays, lack of effective communication, and unsatisfactory treatment resulted in a very poor experience. Patients who are already suffering from pain should not be subjected to such prolonged waiting periods and inadequate care.

I sincerely hope the hospital management takes appropriate steps to improve patient care, service efficiency, communication, and professional conduct to ensure a better experience for future patients.
